links.note: Four parts. Part (a) is the chapter's pre-section framing on anti-colonial nationalism, which has no concept here; the first part with a home is (b), how the First World War helped the national movement - 23853 (war expenditure, taxes, prices, hardship). Parts (c) and (d) reach 23854 and 23860.
Two newspaper reports asked; the answer writes the Jallianwala Bagh one in full, dated Amritsar 13 April 1919. That is 23854. The Simon Commission half has no concept in this frame.
Compares the Bharat Mata images with Germania - 23864, the images and icons that gave nationalism a shared identity. 23865 is the sibling about rewriting history, which this item does not touch.

Chauri Chaura as the reason for calling off Non-Cooperation is 23860's description (withdrawn in February 1922 as the movement turned violent). 23855 is why the movement was launched, not why it ended.

The Oudh Kisan Sabha set up by Jawaharlal Nehru and Baba Ramchandra is the Awadh peasant organisation in 23857. The distractor Alluri Sitaram Raju belongs to 23858, which is how the item separates the countryside from the tribal movement.

Picketing as blocking the entrance to a shop, factory or office is the glossary term attached to the urban phase of Non-Cooperation, where liquor shops were picketed and foreign cloth boycotted - 23856.
